title: CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests
abstract: arXiv:2610.21914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token. Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured.   Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint.   Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps. A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs. Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept.   Results: For all three LLMs the CodeHealth coefficient was negative, with 95% CI excluding zero; each CodeHealth point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% lower token cost. CodeHealth

translated_title: 代码健康度可预测智能体代码审查的Token成本：一项针对465个智能体创建的Pull Request的预注册研究
translated_abstract: 背景：各组织日益将代码审查工作委托给按Token计费的多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线。低代码质量会增加人工维护成本，但其对智能体审查成本的影响尚未被测量。目标：我们检验基线CodeHealth（代码健康度）能否在Pull Request（PR）规模之外预测智能体审查与修复的Token成本。方法：在一项预注册的观察性研究中，我们从AIDev的246个代码仓库中抽样了465个由智能体创建的PR，在仓库数量上限约束下按CodeHealth和PR规模进行联合分层。一条固定的五智能体审查-修复流水线使用三种不同的LLM处理了每个PR。针对每个LLM，我们拟合了以CodeHealth和对数PR规模为自变量、以对数Token数为因变量的混合效应模型，并加入仓库随机截距。结果：对于所有三种LLM，CodeHealth的系数均为负值，且95%置信区间不包含零；CodeHealth每提高1分，Token成本降低3.5%至6.1%。CodeHealth（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 这项预注册研究通过对465个智能体创建的PR进行分层抽样分析，首次证实代码健康度（CodeHealth）能够预测智能体代码审查的Token成本——健康度每提高1分，成本降低3.5%至6.1%，且该效应独立于PR规模。
en_tdlr: This pre-registered study of 465 agent-authored pull requests demonstrates that CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic code review, with each point of CodeHealth associated with a 3.5%–6.1% reduction in cost, independent of PR footprint.
